subject: livi-stewart
q: Livi wrangles Rae — but is she an Anchor? (No longer urgent.)
detail: She corrects, she steadies, she decides. All Anchor-adjacent — but Anchor in this canon means sentinels, blacksmiths and valkyries, and Livi is a strategist-huntress who dominates through precision rather than gravity. Naming her an Anchor no longer moves a number: Rae contests, the figure converts to a floor, her 8.45 clears it. The question is now purely about who Livi is.
